subject: Follow-up: Nebula Health - marketplace purchase and procurement path

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Cc: procurement <procurement@nebulahealth.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: Nebula Health - marketplace purchase and procurement path

Hi Alicia —

Thanks again for taking the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get procurement moving: 

Summary from today's discovery
- Nebula is evaluating a 3-month pilot for inference on ML models (customer-facing clinical summarization workload).
- Preference indicated for a marketplace route if it simplifies finance/ops; procurement also open to PO/invoice for vendors with the right terms.
- Key constraints: PO approvals with net-30/45 timing, vendor tax forms (W9), and standard insurance requirements.

What I attached
- mutual_action_plan_nebula_v1.pdf (outline of stages, owners, and timeline)
- procurement-intake-form.xlsx (basic vendor/billing items your procurement team usually requests)

Questions / ask of your team
1) Primary procurement contact and the email we should use for vendor intake (is ravi.shah@nebulahealth.com the right person?)
2) Preferred commercial path: AWS Marketplace (standalone listing) vs AWS Marketplace Private Offer vs direct PO/invoice. If Marketplace Private Offer, do you need us to create a Private Offer, or do you prefer a Marketplace listing + authorized billing?
3) Any required contractual language/clauses (SLA, data residency, indemnity) we should preemptively include in the first draft PO or SOW?

Proposed next steps
- If procurement prefers Marketplace Private Offer, we'll prepare the PO-ready paperwork + W9 and send the private-offer stub within 2 business days (owner: me).
- Loop in Karthik for a short tech alignment to confirm instance types/throughput for pricing accuracy (owner: karthik_iyer).
- Quick onboarding/checklist call w/ Marissa to align pilot kickoff milestones once PO is submitted (owner: marissa_cole).

Would you be able to confirm the procurement contact and preferred path by EOD tomorrow? That'll let us turn around the vendor paperwork quickly.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this into motion.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0137
Redwood Inference

Ben —

Thanks for the clear summary and the attachments. A few quick clarifications from procurement and our side: 

Procurement position
- Nebula prefers AWS Marketplace Private Offer if Redwood can support invoice/PO terms. Marketplace simplifies approvals for our platform team but procurement still requires vendor paperwork.
- Typical payment terms we accept: net-30, occasionally net-45 for pilot contracts.
- Required items for vendor setup: W9, vendor legal name, EIN, insurance certificate (commercial general liability), and a point of contact for invoicing.

Actions from our end
- I looped in Ravi (procurement) — he will confirm whether Marketplace Private Offer will be acceptable and whether procurement needs a standard PO template filled out. Ravi, can you confirm whether procurement can accept a Marketplace private-offer invoice or if we need a direct vendor PO?

Timing
- We're motivated to start the pilot in Q3; the faster we can get PO/paperwork the better.

One more ask
- Could you send a short doc that explains Redwood's AWS Marketplace private-offer flow (what we receive from AWS and what Redwood provides) and an example invoice cadence? That helps us match internal ops.

Thanks,
Alicia Romero
Head of Product Partnerships, Nebula Health
alicia.romero@nebulahealth.com

Alicia / Ravi —

Appreciate the quick reply and the clarity on procurement needs. Inline answers and next actions below.

Marketplace vs Direct PO
- Redwood supports both: AWS Marketplace Private Offers and direct PO/invoice routes for enterprise customers. For a Private Offer we register the offer and AWS facilitates billing; for direct PO we can invoice Nebula directly under vendor terms. Both workflows can accommodate PO/net-30 or net-45.

What I can provide by EOD today
- vendor_w9_redwood.pdf (W9) — attached
- short one-pager describing the Marketplace Private Offer flow and example invoice cadence (will attach as marketplace-private-offer-flow.pdf)
- standard vendor details (legal name, EIN, billing address) — see procurement-intake-form.xlsx you already have; I'll populate and return.

Requests for procurement
- If procurement can share the PO template or any specific contract clauses up-front (SLA, indemnity caps, data residency), that will speed review.
- If Marketplace Private Offer is preferred, please confirm whether procurement needs Redwood to initiate the Private Offer or if Nebula will request Redwood's listing via the AWS console.

Proposed short plan and owners
- Ben (me): submit W9 + populated intake form + Private Offer one-pager — by EOD today.
- Karthik (karthik_iyer): 30-minute tech alignment to finalize instance sizing for pilot — can do Thu or Fri (owner: karthik_iyer).
- Marissa (marissa_cole): prepare onboarding checklist and preliminary kickoff agenda once PO is accepted (owner: marissa_cole).

If that timeline works, I'll send the forms and the Private Offer doc now and we can set a Thursday slot for the tech alignment.

Thanks — looping in Karthik and Marissa to pick a time.

Best,
Ben Carter
